title: fix(agents): reject FIFO native-hook credentials without blocking
body:
Supersedes #172271, thanks @Leon-SK668.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: the native hook relay hangs when its credential path is a writerless FIFO, even with `--timeout 1000`.

## User Impact

Invalid special-file credentials promptly return the existing deny response. Regular credentials retain the 16 KiB limit and verified HTTPS transport. No configuration or migration is required.

## Why This Change Was Made

Reuse the existing `readRegularFile` from `@openclaw/fs-safe/advanced`, which supplies nonblocking/no-follow opening, regular-file and descriptor checks, bounded reads and cleanup. This removes the duplicate credential-read implementation: production **+8/-19, net -11**. The sibling #191347 already uses this package's regular-file guard; its recovery reader retains its distinct synchronous, ENOENT-only absence contract. No second helper is introduced.

## Evidence

- **RED on main `c83eef98`**: real `mkfifo`, no writer, actual relay CLI with a one-second timeout; bounded child hits `ETIMEDOUT` after ten seconds. HTTPS control passes. Main's credential-reader blob was rechecked unchanged after main advanced.
- **GREEN on Testbox**: same CLI regression returns the existing deny response in **794 ms** and preserves the FIFO. Both remote-client files plus the CLI and CLI import-boundary files pass: **24 tests, four named files**, wrapper **52.09 s** including uncached preparation; remote-client group **2.16 s**. Valid TLS/capability delivery, redirect/response bounds, oversized credentials, cancellation and socket-close settlement remain covered. [Testbox provision run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41512859439).
- [PR CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41514008339) **passed**, 31 successful jobs on exact head `4d3b9811`; elapsed **17m39s**. Merged as `2dd3ffec0063c60ef3815637a2e85c6757a42fd5`.
- Touched-file typed lint: zero warnings/errors; oxfmt/Bun format parity and `git diff --check` pass. Source validation and worker compilation ran on Testbox. PR CI supplies broad proof.
- Local **Codex autoreview, P0–P2, scoped-clean**, complete final local candidate against `c83eef98`, including the allocation record; no actionable findings. Local ClawSweeper is unavailable; the maintainer review route uses autoreview and the hosted ClawSweeper review already queued for this head; no duplicate request was sent. `pr-simplify` keeps one read owner and removes the duplicate low-level read/cleanup sequence.
- Exactly **47 net test lines** are allocated for the bounded real-CLI FIFO regression and retained byte-limit proof; shared scalar unchanged.

Contributor source was read through `gh` only, never checked out or executed. Proof uses synthetic credentials and the real source CLI; native macOS/Windows and an actual model turn were not run. The FIFO regression skips Windows.

Co-authored-by: Leon-SK668 <0668001470@xydigit.com>
